DNK.AbilityStrongTooltip: Physical power and toughness. Roll Strong for muscle, endurance, or brute force.
DNK.AbilitySmartTooltip: Wit and knowledge. Roll Smart for thinking, memory, or cleverness.
DNK.AbilityCuteTooltip: Charm and heart. Roll Cute for charisma, persuasion, or expressiveness.
DNK.HeartTooltip: Health and confidence. Maximum = Strong + Smart. At 0 you're out of play until the end of the scene, or until you rest or are cared for. Regain 1 at lunch and 1 after a night's sleep.
DNK.FurrendshipTooltip: Morale and friendship, maximum = Cute. Spend 1 on a roll for +1 automatic success (up to 4 per test), or to give a friend 1 Heart (not during a Catfight). Entering a Claw Catfight costs 1. Recovered only through a safe night, a good evening with friends, a moving show, or a comrade's character trait.
DNK.CharacterTraitTooltip: A short personality trait. Play it helpfully for an Advantage; play it against yourself for a complication, and give 1 Furr-endship point to a comrade (once per session).
DNK.CattributeTooltip: A unique narrative feature that sets this Kitten apart from every other - describe how it works in the Story tab.
DNK.Name: Name
DNK.Purrecious: Purr-ecious (re-roll a die when it helps)
DNK.RecastCost: Heart cost to recast before the next night's rest
DNK.SpellUsedToday: Already cast today - recasting will cost Heart.
DNK.TripleHint: A positive side effect happens, win or lose.
DNK.NoFailingDie: No failing die left to reroll.
DNK.NoPurrecious: No Purr-ecious item to reroll with.
DNK.MaxFurrendshipReached: You cannot gain more than 4 successes from Furr-endship on a single test.
DNK.InvalidRollMessage: That roll could not be found.
DNK.NotEnoughHeartToRecast: Not enough Heart to recast this (needs {cost}).
DNK.SetAsBlock: Set as Defend (cancels attack successes this turn)
DNK.NoBlockSuccesses: No successes to set as a Block.
DNK.BlockSet: {name} defends: {amount} opponent success(es) can be cancelled this turn.
DNK.BlockAbsorbed: Defend cancelled {block} success(es) against {name}; {remaining} Heart damage applied.
DNK.HealTarget: Heal target(s) (+1 Heart, once per half-day)
DNK.GMOnly: Only the GM can do this.
DNK.NoPartyFound: No party members found (select tokens, or add Kitten actors to the world).
DNK.LunchRestApplied: Lunch rest applied to {count} character(s): +1 Heart, half-day healing reset.
DNK.NightRestApplied: Night's rest applied to {count} character(s): +1 Heart, half-day healing and spell recasts reset.
DNK.CropHint: Drag the box to move it, drag the corner handle to resize. The area inside the box becomes the portrait.

SkillDescription.careOfBeasts: Tending to a sick or injured animal, calming a frightened one, or simply handling beasts safely and gently.
SkillDescription.cook: Turning whatever's on paw into a decent meal, from trail rations to a proper feast.
SkillDescription.drawAndPaint: Sketching, painting, or otherwise capturing something visually - a likeness, a map, a memory.
SkillDescription.findInformation: Digging up facts by asking around, reading, or piecing together rumors and clues.
SkillDescription.findYourWay: Navigating unfamiliar territory, reading a map or the lay of the land, and not getting lost.
SkillDescription.healWoundsAndDiseases: Treating injuries and illness with practical medicine and a steady paw.
SkillDescription.herbology: Identifying, gathering, and using plants - medicinal, edible, or otherwise useful.
SkillDescription.hideInShadows: Staying out of sight by tucking into darkness, cover, or clutter.
SkillDescription.hissAndGrowl: Intimidating someone with a menacing display, a bluff, or a show of force.
SkillDescription.hunterGatherer: Tracking, trapping, foraging, or otherwise living off the land.
SkillDescription.keepCalmAndCarryOn: Staying steady and composed under pressure, fear, or chaos.
SkillDescription.knowledgeOfLawsAndLegends: Recalling laws, customs, old stories, and legends of the world.
SkillDescription.knowledgeOfPeopleAndPlaces: Knowing who's who and what's where - local gossip, geography, and social ties.
SkillDescription.makeMusic: Playing an instrument, singing, or composing something worth listening to.
SkillDescription.moveSilently: Moving without making a sound, sneaking or simply being light-pawed.
SkillDescription.pickpocket: Lifting something from a pocket, bag, or belt without being noticed.
SkillDescription.readSkyAndStars: Reading weather, stars, and seasons to guess what's coming.
SkillDescription.readWriteCount: Literacy and arithmetic - reading a sign, writing a letter, counting coins.
SkillDescription.scratch: Fighting with claws bared - the skill behind a proper Claw Catfight.
SkillDescription.seduceAndCharm: Winning someone over with charm, flattery, or flirtation.
SkillDescription.seeAndSearch: Spotting hidden details, searching a room, or noticing what others miss.
SkillDescription.shakeYourBooty: Balance, agility, and fancy footwork - dancing, tumbling, or catlike grace.
SkillDescription.sweetTalk: Talking your way out of trouble, or into someone's good graces, with words alone.
SkillDescription.tinkerWithBitsAndBobs: Fixing, building, or jury-rigging something out of salvaged parts.
SkillDescription.treatingBeasts: A broader knack for handling animals - riding, training, or simply earning their trust.

OutcomeHint.partial: The player chooses: fail with no further trouble, or succeed anyway at the cost of a complication.
OutcomeHint.failure: No successes - the action is completely botched.

DNK.SelectDieHint: Click a die to choose which one a re-roll replaces (otherwise the first failing die).
DNK.CattributeUsed: The Cattribute re-roll has already been used on this roll.
DNK.AccidentAlreadyRolled: A Meowgic accident has already been rolled for this cast.
DNK.NoMeowgicAllowed: Too badly hurt to use meowgic until the end of the adventure.
DNK.CannotAct: {name} is out of play right now and can't make actions.
DNK.MustFlee: No Furr-endship left to enter a Claw Catfight - the Kitten must run away!
DNK.LeftClaw: {name} is out of the Claw Catfight.
DNK.InClawCatfight: In a Claw Catfight - claws are out!
DNK.FangCatfightNote: Fang Catfight (no one gets truly hurt).
DNK.EnterClawTooltip: A fight to hurt or kill. Entering costs 1 Furr-endship; with none, the Kitten must flee. At 0 Heart in a Claw Catfight, roll for an injury.
DNK.HelpApplied: {name} helps {names} - Advantage on their next roll.
DNK.HelpNoTarget: {name} helps a comrade (target them to hand out the Advantage automatically).
DNK.Conceded: {name} raises their paws and concedes the Catfight.
DNK.Pampered: {name} hugs {target} and purrs in their ear: -1 Furr-endship, +1 Heart.
DNK.PamperTooltip: Spend 1 Furr-endship to give 1 Heart to the targeted friend (not during a Catfight).
DNK.TraitAlreadyUsed: Already used this way this session.
DNK.TraitNeedsComrade: Target the comrade who recovers the Furr-endship.
DNK.TraitPositive: {name} leans into being {trait} - Advantage on the next roll.
DNK.TraitPositiveTooltip: Once per session: play your trait helpfully to gain an Advantage.
DNK.TraitNegativeTooltip: Once per session: let your trait cause trouble; the targeted comrade recovers 1 Furr-endship.
DNK.InjuryDays: Out of action for {days} day(s) - each night's rest counts one down.
DNK.AbilityAlreadyLost: The ability point has already been chosen.
DNK.NotOwner: Only the character's owner can choose.
DNK.ExperienceTooltip: Current (unspent) / total earned. +1 per session, +1 more for finishing an adventure or reaching a goal.
DNK.SessionEnded: Session ended: +1 experience to {count} Kitten(s); character traits refreshed.
DNK.AdventureCompleted: Adventure complete: +1 experience to {count} Kitten(s); adventure-long injuries healed.
DNK.ChooseChildhood: Choose a Childhood (sets Cattribute and adds five Purr-ecious items)
DNK.ChildhoodApplyHint: Applying replaces the Cattribute and adds the five items to the backpack.
DNK.CreationTooltip: A new Kitten splits 8 points across Strong, Smart, and Cute, each between 1 and 5.
DNK.FangAttackTooltip: Strong or Cute + almost any skill. Each success costs the target 1 Heart. Nobody is really hurt.
DNK.ClawAttackTooltip: Strong or Smart + Scratch only; weapons re-roll if they're Purr-ecious. Enters a Claw Catfight first (-1 Furr-endship).
DNK.HinderTooltip: At least 1 success gives an opponent a Disadvantage.
DNK.DefendTooltip: Strong or Smart + Keep Calm & Carry On or Shake Your Booty. Successes cancel attack successes against you or your comrades this turn.
DNK.HelpTooltip: Automatic, no roll: target a comrade to give them an Advantage.
DNK.MoveTooltip: A big move or stunt; Strong or Smart + Shake Your Booty if it's risky. Can also be used to hide or sneak.
DNK.InteractTooltip: Talk, pick a lock, tend a comrade - anything that isn't an attack.
DNK.HealAllyTooltip: A successful Smart test heals 1 Heart on the targeted comrade - once per half-day per recipient.
DNK.ConcedeTooltip: Raise your paws: you're out of this Fang Catfight without the consequences of defeat.
DNK.FleeTooltip: Smart + Shake Your Booty to escape a Claw Catfight. Leave the Claw Catfight once you're clear.
DNK.SurrenderTooltip: Cute + Seduce & Charm to give up a Claw Catfight safely. Leave the Claw Catfight once it's accepted.
DNK.CatfightHint: Players choose who acts first. An aggressive action hands the initiative to the other side; a non-aggressive one lets another player go. Target a token before using a chat-card button that affects someone else.
DNK.SpellbookHint: Each spell is free once a day; recasting costs 1 Heart until a night's rest. A failed cast can be forced through with a Meowgic accident roll. Drag spells in from the Spells compendium.
DNK.PurreciousSlotsTooltip: A Kitten carries at most five Purr-ecious items (more from a Bearcub childhood or experience). Everyday supplies don't count.
DNK.PurreciousTooltip: When this item could help with an action, it lets you re-roll a die.
DNK.SlotFreeTooltip: For things like the Young Noble's inheritance coins, which don't count toward the five-item limit.
DNK.ExtraDescriptionTooltip: A line of appearance and character. When it fits what the Extra is doing, they get a re-roll.
DNK.ExtraBuildHint: Weak 6 ability points, 1 skill, 1 item · Average 8, 2 skills, 1-2 spells · Strong 10, 3 skills · Very strong 12, 4 skills.
DNK.SpellPathTooltip: The path decides the casting ability: Tower/Great Hall use Strong, Craft/Country Smart, City/Caravan Cute.
DNK.SpellLevelTooltip: The spell's level is the number of successes it needs.
DNK.RecastTooltip: Recasting a spell already cast today costs Heart (1 by the rules) until the next night's rest.
